notices: Reference mode: consensus5; 5 reference reading(s). Word and window features use the median; the reference audio, waveform and word times are the first reading.

Regime R2: a different performance; pace, pauses, pitch variation, volume are scored; emphasis, clarity are displayed only. Local pace, pitch-range and volume flags compare each stretch with the recording's own overall tempo, pitch range or level. A whole-clip difference in tempo and pitch range is flagged separately. Pauses are compared one by one only: a shortened pause is flagged beyond the threshold in the note below. The same physical deviation scores differently in R1 and R2.

Flags are acoustic departures from reference features; pattern names describe the measured evidence, not a diagnosis. Timing is word-boundary resolution, except evidence spans: a silence or a held sound inside a word comes from 10 ms frame measures, and inserted material or a voiced run in a gap comes from the 20 ms speech-recogniser decode.

Listed, not scored for a different performance: word time, ending, speech tempo. Their departures appear in the 'Listed, not scored' panel and cost no points. Speech tempo: for a different speaker it did not separate rushed words from normal speaker differences: scored in development, it flagged 0 of 68 rush edits of other readers. In the final run, as a listed entry, it lies on 10 of 20 natural-rush edits of the check readers (one reference, levels 2 and 3).
